name: university-fleet-management
description: Web-Based University Fleet Management System with real-time tracking and predictive maintenance (ABU Zaria)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,gps -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run simulator --prefix backend"
